intro: Your stack (Python/FastAPI, ADK + LangGraph, Vertex/Gemini, GKE/Cloud Run/Pub/Sub, RAG on ChromaDB, NER with HF Transformers, evals) maps most directly to applied-LLM and agent-platform roles. Pick one PRIMARY track and one SECONDARY track; the tracks change how much weight you give each module, not what you learn.

weightLegend.3: Core — be able to whiteboard it cold
weightLegend.2: Solid — defend resume claims + basic design

roles.title: Senior Applied AI / LLM Engineer
roles.tagline: Ship RAG + agent features to production and own quality, latency and cost.
roles.targetCompanies: Product companies shipping LLM features (fintech, media, SaaS, e-commerce), AI-first startups, big-tech applied teams, and GenAI practices at consultancies.
whatTheyTest: Design an end-to-end RAG / assistant system with a latency, cost and quality budget
Retrieval quality: chunking, hybrid search, reranking, evals
Reliability: caching, fallbacks, guardrails, observability
Defending your own projects at 10x–100x scale
gapsToClose: Online evals + A/B testing of prompts/models (not just offline golden sets)
A concrete story for cost per request and how you reduced it
Know one non-GCP equivalent for each service you used (Pub/Sub→Kafka/SQS, Vertex Vector Search→pgvector/Pinecone/Qdrant, GKE→EKS)
roles.resumeFraming: Lead with Deloitte multi-agent support (quantified savings + latency) and the multimodal asset RAG. Network18 NER/video pipelines show breadth.

roles.title: AI Agent / Agentic Platform Engineer
roles.tagline: Build the orchestration, state, tool and safety layers agents run on.
roles.targetCompanies: Agent-focused startups, developer-tool and workflow-automation companies, and enterprise platform teams building internal agent frameworks.
whatTheyTest: Agent topologies, tool-calling protocols (MCP/A2A), planning vs. reactive loops
Durable state, checkpointing, resumability, idempotent tools
Failure handling: retries, sagas, loop/budget limits, human-in-the-loop
Sandboxing, scoped permissions, prompt-injection defense
Evaluating non-deterministic multi-step systems
gapsToClose: Durable execution engines (Temporal / Workflow-style) — know why checkpointing in Redis is not the same thing
Trace-based debugging of agent runs (OpenTelemetry spans per tool call)
roles.resumeFraming: Make the Deloitte orchestrator the centerpiece: topology choice, state store, failure modes, TTFT budget.

roles.title: LLM Platform / Inference Infrastructure Engineer
roles.fit: Stretch — needs ~4–6 weeks of extra serving depth
roles.tagline: Own model serving, batching, GPU cost and the gateway in front of it.
roles.targetCompanies: Model providers, inference-hosting companies, and larger orgs with in-house GPU fleets and internal LLM platforms.
whatTheyTest: KV cache, continuous batching, paged attention, quantization, speculative decoding
GPU capacity planning, autoscaling on queue depth / tokens-per-second
Multi-tenant gateway: quotas, routing, fallback, per-team cost attribution
Kubernetes at depth (GPU scheduling, node pools, rollouts)
gapsToClose: Hands-on: run vLLM or TGI yourself and benchmark TTFT / tokens-per-second at different batch sizes
GPU basics: memory bandwidth vs. compute bound, tensor parallelism, FlashAttention
Your resume is API-consumer heavy — be honest and show the NER serving work as your inference experience
roles.resumeFraming: Lead with high-QPS NER serving, the $1.3M cost savings, and GKE operations.

roles.title: AI Solutions Architect / Forward-Deployed Engineer
roles.fit: Good fit — consulting background is a real advantage
roles.tagline: Turn a customer's messy problem into a deployed, defensible AI system.
roles.targetCompanies: Cloud and model vendors' customer-facing teams, AI startups with enterprise customers, and consultancies' AI/architecture practices.
whatTheyTest: Requirements gathering from vague prompts; scoping and phasing
Security, RBAC, data residency, compliance in enterprise RAG
Build vs. buy and cost/ROI conversations
Clear communication: diagrams, trade-offs, risk
gapsToClose: Multi-cloud vocabulary: you will meet AWS/Azure customers
ROI stories: translate the 3,500+ man-hours and $1.3M savings into repeatable business cases
roles.resumeFraming: Deloitte client delivery is your edge. Show requirements → design → measured business impact.

roles.title: Machine Learning Engineer (Data / NLP leaning)
roles.fit: Good fit — requires classical ML system design on top
roles.tagline: Train, serve and monitor models and data pipelines at scale.
roles.targetCompanies: Media, fintech, marketplaces and search/recommendation teams; companies with established ML platforms.
whatTheyTest: Classic ML system design: feature stores, training pipelines, offline vs. online serving
Streaming vs. batch data pipelines, BigQuery/Spark performance
Model monitoring, drift, retraining triggers
NLP-specific serving (batching, quantization, ONNX)
gapsToClose: Recommendation / ranking system design (two-tower retrieval, ranking, feature store) — not covered here yet
Experimentation: A/B test design, metric sensitivity, guardrail metrics
Drift detection and retraining pipelines (e.g. Vertex AI Pipelines / Kubeflow-style)
roles.resumeFraming: Lead with Network18 multilingual NER (80–90% F1, 600+ articles/day) and BigQuery/PySpark reporting automation.

weeks.focus: Fundamentals: replication, partitioning, consistency, queues vs logs
Mocks: 1 problem every other day, then the capstone
